title: Internship in Computational Biophysics for Protein Property Prediction (all genders)
desc:
Ready to grow your skills while helping shape the future of healthcare? At Sanofi, you’ll be empowered to learn, ask questions, and bring your ideas to life – all while supported by inspiring mentors and collaborative teams

About Sanofi
Join the engine of Sanofi’s mission — where deep immunoscience meets bold, AI-powered research. In R&D, you’ll drive breakthroughs that could turn the impossible into possible for millions.

About us
The Virtual Screening and Property Prediction group is part of the Digital Biologics Platform (DBxP) in Sanofi R&D. We develop and apply physics-based modeling, molecular simulation and machine learning workflows to support the discovery and optimization of therapeutic proteins (antibodies and nanobodies®). Be part of our team Computational Biophysics for Protein Property Prediction as an intern.

Job Description
Predicting protein properties such as stability and aggregation is an important part of developing protein therapeutics. Proteins are flexible molecules, and their conformational dynamics can affect how they behave in experiments. In this internship, you will investigate whether information from molecular simulations can help predict these properties, using in-house experimental data.

Your tasks:

• Set up, run and analyze Molecular Dynamics and Monte Carlo simulations of proteins, mainly antibodies and nanobodies.

• Calculate descriptors from the simulations (e.g. flexibility, conformational ensemble characterization, surface properties) and relate them to experimental data.

• Build a predictive workflow that combines simulation-derived descriptors with statistical or machine learning models.

• Benchmark publicly available prediction tools, including generative AI for structural ensemble prediction, against Sanofi in-house data.

• Present your results to computational and experimental colleagues and document the workflow.

Requirements & Qualifications

• You are currently enrolled in full-time in a master’s program in biophysics, computational chemistry, structural biology, bioinformatics, physics or a related field
• Mandatory internship of 6 months
• Experience with Molecular Dynamics and/or Monte Carlo simulations and classical molecular modeling (e.g. GROMACS, AMBER, OpenMM, Rosetta, Maestro, MOE, pymol, etc.)
• Programming skills in Python and experience working in Linux environments.
• Knowledge of protein structure, in particular antibodies or nanobodies, is a plus.
• Experience with AI or machine learning (e.g. scikit-learn, PyTorch, protein language models, structure prediction tools) is a plus.
• Curiosity, independence, structured way of working, good communication skills and enjoyment of teamwork.
• Fluent English, written and spoken

Why Choose Us

• Bring the miracles of science to life alongside a supportive, future-focused team

• An international work environment, in which you can develop your talent and realize ideas and innovations within a competent team

• Discover endless opportunities to grow your talent and drive your career, whether it’s through a promotion or lateral move, at home or internationally

• Benefit from our mobile office policy working up to 60% hybrid, depending on the area of assignment, within Germany

• Play an instrumental part in creating best practice

• Start your career at our Frankfurt site and experience our modern working environment

Pursue progress, discover extraordinary
Better is out there. Better medications, better outcomes, better science. But progress doesn’t happen without people – people from different backgrounds, in different locations, doing different roles, all united by one thing: a desire to make miracles happen. So, let’s be those people.

At Sanofi, we provide equal opportunities to all regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, ability or gender identity.

Watch our ALL IN video and check out our Diversity Equity and Inclusion actions at sanofi.com!

title: Werkstudent*in Administration Vertrieb/Sales
desc:
Sanofi erforscht, entwickelt und vermarktet therapeutische Lösungen – als lebenslanger Begleiter in Gesundheitsfragen.
Der Hauptsitz des Konzerns ist in Paris. Die deutsche Landesgesellschaft unterhält ihren größten Standort in Frankfurt am Main.

Für unseren Standort im Herzen von BERLIN (Nähe Park Gleisdreieck) suchen ab dem nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt administrative Unterstützung (15-20h/Woche) im Team Sales Immunology.

• Sponsoring-Management: Anlegen und Verwaltung von Sponsorings
• Veranstaltungsmanagement: Organisation von Veranstaltungen und Fallkonferenzen (Anlegen in Veeva, Hotelbuchungen, Vertragsmanagement etc.)
• Musterbestellungen: Auslösen von Musterbestellungen, Eingabe und Upload von Formularen in Veeva
• Teamkoordination: Abstimmung mit verschiedenen Teams
• Unterstützung des Teams bei weiteren spannenden Aufgaben & Projekten

Dein Profil

• Du bist ordnungsgemäß immatrikuliert, gerne im Bereich der Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Gesundheitsmanagement, o.Ä.
• Du überzeugst als kommunikative, proaktive und zuverlässige Persönlichkeit
• Du behältst auch bei parallelen Projekten den Überblick
• Du arbeitest Dich schnell in neue Themengebiete ein

Folgende Interessen und Kenntnisse bringst du mit

• Eine selbstständige, zuverlässige und teamorientierte Arbeitsweise ist für Dich selbstverständlich
• Du bist sicher im Umgang mit Office 365 (Excel, Power Point, Word, Teams) sowie idealerweise erste CRM-Erfahrungen (Veeva) mit
• Interesse an der Einarbeitung in neue digitale Anwendungen und Systeme
• Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Wir bieten Dir:

• Ein faires Bruttogehalt und bezahlten Urlaub
• Flexible Arbeitszeiten anteilig mit der Möglichkeit, von zu Hause auszuarbeiten
• Ein modernes, internationales Arbeitsumfeld
• Eine individuelle und strukturierte Einarbeitung in Deine Aufgaben

title: Switzerland IBCM Graduate 2027 (f/m/x)
desc:
Job Description:
About the programme
Graduates are entry level, fulltime employees in the bank’s non-infrastructure divisions who join the bank’s Graduate Training programme. Employees are classified as graduates for a 12-24 month period post the start of the Graduate Training programme. Graduates gain practical first-hand experience of the bank from experienced employees, developing skills in line with the bank's training program and learn about the inner workings of the bank and their specific divisions.
This is a rare opportunity to join Deutsche Bank’s Swiss Corporate Finance Team in Zurich as a full-time Investment Banking Analyst. As a career starter in Deutsche Bank’s Investment Bank (IB), you will be an important team member in the origination and execution of the bank’s corporate finance business.

About the division
Our Corporate Finance franchise provides the full range of integrated investment banking products and services for our clients across industries, including financial advisory in M&A, equity and debt capital markets transactions and leveraged buyouts.
As an Investment Banking Analyst in our Zurich office, you will contribute to the bank’s M&A execution and capital raising abilities while building our reputation in the Swiss market with the seamless execution of corporate finance transactions. As part of this role you will work with product and sector experts based across the globe, thereby gaining experience in a wide array of industries and products.
You will experience excellent financial and modelling training, gain hands-on learning experiences and develop skills in all major areas of investment banking with the aim of being able to execute large corporate transactions.

What we look for

• University degree (BSc or MSc), ideally in Banking, Finance, Accounting or Economics.
• Prior internship experience in Corporate Finance / M&A, preferably with a leading investment bank or boutique.
• Strong numerical, analytical and financial modelling skills, with a focus on quality and attention to detail.
• Ability to support senior bankers in originating, structuring and executing transactions through financial and valuation analyses, client research, presentations and due diligence.
• Self-motivation, independence under pressure, creative problem-solving and strong communication skills, with maturity and a commitment to integrity and teamwork.
• Excellent oral and written command of English and German.
• Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.

To be eligible for the 2027 Graduate Programme you must:

• Complete your studies (all final exams, coursework and have no outstanding requirements for graduation) between 1st January 2026 and 31st July 2027.
• Be able to start full time work in July 2027, subject to local working legislation and visa requirements.
• Possess no more than 12 months full-time, relevant work experience.

Benefits and wellbeing:
· Emotionally and mentally balanced: We support you in dealing with life crises, maintaining stability through illness, and maintaining good mental health. Our corporate culture promotes dialogue and encourages sharing opinions and feedback (speak-up culture).
· Physically thriving: We support you managing your physical health by taking appropriate preventive measures and providing a workplace that helps you thrive.
· Socially connected: We strongly believe in collaboration, inclusion and feeling connected to open up new perspectives and strengthen our self-confidence and well-being.
· Financially secure: We support you to meet personal financial goals during your active career and for the future.
About us and our teams:
Our values define the working environment we strive to create – where our people have a sense of belonging and everyone feels welcomed, respected and can contribute and grow. We know that high-performing teams have different skills, backgrounds, and experiences. We collaborate, encourage and enable open dialogue and diversity of views. We build talented and diverse teams to drive business results and encourage our people to develop to their full potential. Talk to us about flexible work arrangements and other initiatives we offer.
We promote good working relationships and encourage high standards of conduct and work performance. We welcome applications from talented people from all cultures, countries, races, genders, sexual orientations, disabilities, beliefs and generations and are committed to providing a working environment free from harassment, discrimination and retaliation.

Visit Inside Deutsche Bank to discover more about the culture of Deutsche Bank including Diversity & Inclusion, Leadership, Learning, Future of Work and more besides.

How to apply:
You'll find a wealth of helpful tools and information on our Employability Hub that will support you with your application, prepare for the assessment processes and adapt to a new working environment. Please visit our Careers Website to apply.
Please include your current CV, transcripts of records (A-levels and University) and internship/employment references to your application.
A notice on Recruitment Scams

We strive for a culture in which we are empowered to excel together every day. This includes acting responsibly, thinking commercially, taking initiative and working collaboratively.
Together we share and celebrate the successes of our people. Together we are Deutsche Bank Group.

We welcome applications from all people and promote a positive, fair and inclusive work environment.
